page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for compute-focused workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk storage. It is suitable for tasks such as web serving, batch processing, and distributed compute nodes where CPU allocation is prioritized over memory capacity.
